# XY Forever serial protocol 1.28: package and storage reports

Part of the [XY Forever serial protocol 1.28](../PROTOCOL.md).

### 0x49 `package.list`

List packages and their exact identity. One item per page, in filesystem order. Start both cursors at zero and use the returned cursors until more is zero. Area
2 walks mods/<generation>/<package>. Item keys: id (relative to area), type, version, sha256 (manifest image hash, or single-file hash), identity (SHA-256 of
exact files.sha256 bytes; absent list: the single file itself), needs_os, generation, profile, valid (strict manifest admitted; 0 for legacy or unknown). Inbox
files are recognised by bytes, never extension. Unknown or incomplete folders remain visible with valid=0 and an empty identity when no list or single image
exists. The caller waits up to 600 seconds (large official inbox files are streamed, never buffered whole). Hashing is streamed in menu-loop slices while other
storage commands return busy. Directory contents may change between pages; use package.session for a stable cooperative snapshot. This read never changes
admission or legacy boot semantics.

| Request field (16 bytes) | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `version` | u32 | API version: 1; newer is unsupported |
| `area` | u32 | 0 inbox, 1 firmware library, 2 mods (0..2) |
| `outer` | u32 | cursor, initially 0 |
| `inner` | u32 | mod-package cursor within generation; otherwise 0 |

| Reply field, after the status (16 to 996 bytes) | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `version` | u32 | reply format: 1 |
| `outer` | u32 | next cursor |
| `inner` | u32 | next inner cursor |
| `more` | u32 | 1: request next page, 0: end (0..1) |
| `item` | rest, 0..980 B | At most one item: LF key=value ASCII text; empty on end |

On an error: the status only. Errors: `bad_request`, `unsupported`, `busy`, `link`, `storage`, `not_found`, `too_large`. The reply never gains fields (it ends
in `rest`). Tool timeout: 600 s. Build switch `XYF_USB_FILE_WRITE`, not optional: the firmware does not build without it. Since 1.21.

### 0x4a `state.get`

Read boot slots, content record and durable job intent. Pages the existing records without rewriting or interpreting unknown fields. The journal falls back to
job.old when job.txt is absent; content falls back to content-state.old. A missing part is not_found. The valid highest-sequence boot slot wins, with the
existing legacy fallback. Journal version 1 names target, previous entry, source identities, default intent and undo direction; a newer or malformed journal
stays on disk and the menu explains the refusal. Missing source: the menu offers Set default to the previous entry, also available through library.set_default;
no separate repair command.

| Request field (12 bytes) | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `version` | u32 | API version: 1; newer is unsupported |
| `part` | u32 | 0 state-a, 1 state-b, 2 legacy state, 3 content-state, 4 journal (0..4) |
| `offset` | u32 | byte offset |

| Reply field, after the status (16 to 1020 bytes) | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `version` | u32 | reply format: 1 |
| `part` | u32 | requested part |
| `offset` | u32 | requested offset |
| `more` | u32 | 1: another page may follow (0..1) |
| `text` | rest, 0..1004 B | Exact stored bytes (up to 1004); slot CRCs and journal version remain visible |

On an error: the status only. Errors: `bad_request`, `unsupported`, `busy`, `link`, `storage`, `not_found`, `range`. The reply never gains fields (it ends in
`rest`). Tool timeout: 60 s. Build switch `XYF_USB_FILE_WRITE`, not optional: the firmware does not build without it. Since 1.21.

### 0x4b `storage.space`

Report free storage bytes. Uses the existing read-only statfs query (0x23) on /yaffs2: unsigned block size times free blocks, returned as a 64-bit byte count in
two little-endian words. A successful statfs return accepts a stale YAFFS errno; a zero block size is storage failure, and zero free blocks is valid. Does not
mount storage for writing.

| Request field (4 bytes) | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `version` | u32 | API version: 1; newer is unsupported |

| Reply field, after the status (12 bytes) | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `version` | u32 | reply format: 1 |
| `free_low` | u32 | low 32 bits of free bytes |
| `free_high` | u32 | high 32 bits of free bytes |

On an error: the status only. Errors: `bad_request`, `unsupported`, `busy`, `link`, `storage`, `not_found`. Tool timeout: 60 s. Build switch
`XYF_USB_FILE_WRITE`, not optional: the firmware does not build without it. Since 1.21.

### 0x4c `dev.a_rehearsal`

Transfer staged B input to A and admit it without writing. Developer RAM-only rehearsal. Starts from the current stage.end-verified B input. Transfers
contiguous chunks into A-owned staging, checks chunk and full CRC/SHA on A, and applies the existing boot.install or boot.uninstall policy independently on A.
Poll status until phase 0; result 0 plus A SHA-256 proves admission. Cancel and deadline abort the transfer. Success collects A proof then releases A ownership.
No boot-partition write, filesystem write, read-write mount or reset. A delayed request never blocks USB/status. A link failure stops without reset, retry or
fallback; ordinary lost-link behavior is retained. Shipping boot.install and boot.uninstall are unchanged.

| Request field (8 to 48 bytes) | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `version` | u32 | format 1; newer is unsupported |
| `operation` | u32 | 0 start, 1 status, 2 cancel |
| `kind` | u32 | Optional. Start only: 0 XY Forever install, 1 exact stock uninstall |
| `deadline_ms` | u32 | Optional. Start only: 1..120000 ms |
| `sha256` | bytes[32] | Optional. Start only: staged input token |

| Reply field, after the status (56 bytes) | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `version` | u32 | reply format 1 |
| `phase` | u32 | 0 finished or idle, 1..8 cooperative transfer phase |
| `done` | u32 | A-acknowledged bytes |
| `total` | u32 | input bytes |
| `crc32` | u32 | staged input CRC-32 |
| `result` | u32 | terminal status; meaningful when phase is 0 |
| `sha256` | bytes[32] | A-computed readback digest; zero until admission |

On an error: the status only. Errors: `bad_request`, `unsupported`, `state`, `sha`, `busy`. Tool timeout: 5 s. Build switch `XYF_TFW_CHECK` (on in product
builds; without it: `unsupported`). Since 1.22.
